name: Appointment Reminder Agent
headline: Confirm, change, or cancel before the slot is lost.
prompt: I am calling about your upcoming appointment.
description: Contacts patients before appointments and lets them confirm, cancel, or request rescheduling. Production deployments must account for consent, identity, accessibility, and healthcare privacy requirements.
readiness: Illustrative workflow; validate consent, identity, scheduling integration, accessibility, and healthcare privacy requirements.

business.buyer: Patient access and ambulatory operations leaders
business.application: Contact patients before appointments and let them confirm, cancel, or request a different time.
business.roi: Reduce no-shows, recover appointment capacity, and lower manual reminder effort.

technical.systems: Scheduling system · Patient contact data · Telephony
technical.build: Outbound campaigns, identity checks, confirmation, cancellation, reschedule handoff, and consent.

expected.description: Poster image for the video player (WebP).
